headline: Linn Mercy and Weathered Expanse Lead Front Activity
war_summary: The latest watch finds the contest concentrated in a handful of shifting sectors. Weathered Expanse has climbed to 58 strategic-base events, with four in the newest two hours, while its six Warden and three Colonial holdings remain unsettled. Linn Mercy stands at 27 events, three in the latest watch, and retains a narrow Warden lead of six bases to five. Stlican Shelf, previously quiet in the last edition, now records 37 events, including eight in two hours, with five Warden and four Colonial bases. Stonecradle has edged to 27 events and shows two fresh movements, its holdings divided five to three with one strategic base neutral. Viper Pit has emerged as another active station: five events arrived in the latest two hours, seven over the day, amid seven Warden and one Colonial bases. Fisherman’s Row has cooled from its earlier burst but still totals 14 events, including two recent, with seven Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral base. Godcrofts remains active in the broader ledger at 22 events but has gone quiet in the latest two hours. No victor is declared.
